title: The San Andreas Mission to Play Before GTA 6: A Look Back at Rockstar's Cinematic Roots
description: Before playing GTA 6, IGN recommends revisiting the iconic 'Reuniting the Families' mission in GTA San Andreas, showcasing early Rockstar cinematic flair.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The San Andreas Mission You Need to Play Before GTA 6

As anticipation reaches an all-time high for the next installment in Rockstar Games' legendary franchise, gamers and critics alike are looking back at the milestones that shaped the series. Recently, gaming media outlet IGN highlighted a standout moment from the past: the 'Reuniting the Families' mission in *Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas*. For fans eagerly waiting for *GTA 6*, revisiting this classic offers a fascinating look at how Rockstar first mastered its signature cinematic flair.

### High-Octane Chaos and Cinematic Flair

According to IGN, the 'Reuniting the Families' mission delivers an unforgettable blend of intense car chases, explosive shootouts, and memorable moments featuring cops recreating iconic scenes from *Terminator 2*. Encapsulated by the chaotic sentiment of 'It's Every Motherf***er for Himself!', the level showcases the sheer scale of panic and action that Rockstar was beginning to master during the era. It stands out as a prime example of the developer successfully bridging the gap between open-world gameplay and Hollywood-style action direction.

### Connecting the Past to the Future of Open-World Gaming

While the source material focuses purely on the retrospective evaluation of *San Andreas*, industry analysis often suggests that the foundational storytelling techniques developed during this era paved the way for modern masterpieces. The ambition to create living, breathing worlds driven by cinematic narratives is a direct lineage that continues into the upcoming release of *GTA 6*.

Taking the time to replay these classic missions provides great context while we await further official updates regarding *GTA 6*.

## Editor's Take
IGN's spotlight on this classic mission reminds us why Rockstar's legacy is so enduring. The seamless blending of high-stakes action and cinematic presentation seen in *San Andreas* laid the groundwork for modern open-world design, and it remains a masterclass that every fan should experience while anticipating *GTA 6*.
